about:
Build the --require-stereo hostile input set: structures that a rule
requiring fully specified stereochemistry must sort into "pass" (every real
stereo element fixed, or none) and "block" (a real stereo element whose
configuration the input does not fix), each with what the gate should do.

cases.name: smi_benzene
cases.why: no stereo element

cases.name: smi_ethanol
cases.why: no stereo element

cases.name: smi_3pentanol
cases.why: two identical ethyls: not a stereocentre

cases.name: smi_isobutylene
cases.why: two identical methyls on one end: no E/Z

cases.name: smi_propene
cases.why: a terminal =CH2: no E/Z

cases.name: smi_tetramethylethylene
cases.why: identical pairs on both ends: no E/Z

cases.name: smi_cyclohexene
cases.why: a double bond in a six-ring is always cis

cases.name: smi_cycloheptene
cases.why: a seven-ring double bond is cis in practice

cases.name: smi_butadiene
cases.why: s-cis/s-trans are conformers, not stereoisomers

cases.name: smi_nmethylacetamide
cases.why: amide rotamers are conformers, not stereoisomers

cases.name: smi_triethylamine_like
cases.why: a tertiary amine inverts in microseconds: not a stereocentre

cases.name: smi_cyclohexanone_4tbu_sym
cases.why: C4 sees two identical ring arms: no stereo

cases.name: smi_stereo_mark_on_nothing
cases.why: an @ on an atom with two methyls marks nothing real

cases.name: smi_ala_S
cases.why: one centre, specified

cases.name: smi_ala_unspec
cases.why: one centre unspecified; the enantiomers' ESP is mirrored, but the flag promises a fixed isomer

cases.name: smi_ala_explicitH
cases.why: specified with an explicit H in the SMILES

cases.name: smi_threonine_full
cases.why: two centres, both specified

cases.name: smi_threonine_half
cases.why: one of two centres specified: diastereomers differ

cases.name: smi_threonine_none
cases.why: two centres unspecified: four stereoisomers, two diastereomer pairs

cases.name: smi_tartaric_meso
cases.why: meso tartaric acid: both centres specified

cases.name: smi_tartaric_unspec
cases.why: meso or (R,R)/(S,S): different compounds

cases.name: smi_trihydroxyglutaric_C3_unspec
cases.why: C2 and C4 fixed meso-like; C3 is pseudo-asymmetric (r/s) and unspecified

cases.name: smi_trihydroxyglutaric_full
cases.why: every centre specified, C3 included

cases.name: smi_cholesterol_full
cases.why: eight centres, all specified

cases.name: smi_cholesterol_none
cases.why: eight centres unspecified: 256 stereoisomers

cases.name: smi_glucose_open_partial
cases.why: one of four centres left unspecified

cases.name: smi_14dimethylcyclohexane_unspec
cases.why: cis and trans are different compounds, though neither carbon is a CIP centre

cases.name: smi_14dimethylcyclohexane_trans
cases.why: ring stereo specified

cases.name: smi_12dimethylcyclohexane_cis
cases.why: cis, meso: specified

cases.name: smi_decalin_unspec
cases.why: cis- or trans-decalin

cases.name: smi_decalin_trans
cases.why: ring junction specified

cases.name: smi_sulfoxide_unspec
cases.why: a sulfoxide S is a configurationally stable stereocentre

cases.name: smi_sulfoxide_spec
cases.why: sulfoxide specified

cases.name: smi_phosphine_unspec
cases.why: a phosphine P(III) inverts only above ~30 kcal/mol: stable

cases.name: smi_phosphine_spec
cases.why: phosphine specified

cases.name: smi_ammonium_unspec
cases.why: a quaternary N with four different groups cannot invert

cases.name: smi_ammonium_spec
cases.why: quaternary N specified

cases.name: smi_troger_unspec
cases.why: Troeger's base: bridgehead N cannot invert

cases.name: smi_aziridine_N
cases.why: the N is the only candidate; an N-alkyl aziridine inverts at roughly 17-19 kcal/mol, slowly but at room temperature: whether it counts is a judgement call

cases.name: smi_aziridine_C_unspec
cases.why: the ring carbon is a real stereocentre, unspecified

cases.name: smi_2butene_unspec
cases.why: E and Z are different compounds

cases.name: smi_2butene_E
cases.why: E specified

cases.name: smi_2butene_Z
cases.why: Z specified

cases.name: smi_hexadiene_half
cases.why: one of two E/Z bonds specified

cases.name: smi_hexadiene_full
cases.why: both specified

cases.name: smi_cyclooctene_unspec
cases.why: an eight-ring double bond can be E: trans-cyclooctene is isolable

cases.name: smi_cyclooctene_Z
cases.why: cis-cyclooctene specified

cases.name: smi_cyclodecene_unspec
cases.why: a ten-ring double bond: E and Z both stable

cases.name: smi_oxime_unspec
cases.why: oxime E/Z isomers are separable

cases.name: smi_oxime_E
cases.why: oxime specified

cases.name: smi_nmethylimine_unspec
cases.why: an N-alkyl ketimine has E/Z isomers

cases.name: smi_azobenzene_unspec
cases.why: cis- and trans-azobenzene

cases.name: smi_azobenzene_E
cases.why: trans-azobenzene specified

cases.name: smi_NH_imine
cases.why: an N-H imine's E/Z interconvert quickly (tautomerism): whether it counts is a judgement call

cases.name: smi_enolate_unspec
cases.why: E and Z enolates are different species

cases.name: smi_enolate_Z
cases.why: enolate specified

cases.name: smi_allene_unspec
cases.why: 1,3-dimethylallene is axially chiral: two enantiomers

cases.name: smi_allene_achiral
cases.why: two identical methyls on one end: no axial chirality

cases.name: smi_butatriene_unspec
cases.why: an even cumulene has cis/trans isomers

cases.name: smi_binol
cases.why: BINOL's atropisomers are configurationally stable (barrier ~37 kcal/mol); SMILES cannot fix them

cases.name: smi_biphenyl_ortho1
cases.why: one ortho methyl: rotation is free at room temperature

cases.name: smi_nitro_biphenyl
cases.why: 6,6'-dimethyl-2,2'-dinitrobiphenyl: the classic resolved atropisomer; SMILES cannot fix it

cases.name: smi_tetramethylbiphenyl
cases.why: four ortho methyls, but each ring is symmetric: no atropisomers

cases.name: smi_helicene6
cases.why: [6]helicene: P and M helices, barrier ~36 kcal/mol; SMILES cannot fix the helix

cases.name: smi_ethylidene_cyclohexane
cases.why: 1-ethylidene-4-methylcyclohexane is axially chiral, with no stereocentre and no E/Z

cases.name: smi_camphor_unspec
cases.why: camphor's two bridgeheads: (+) and (-) camphor

cases.name: smi_camphor_spec
cases.why: (1R,4R)-camphor specified

cases.name: smi_spiro_unspec
cases.why: 2,6-dimethylspiro[3.3]heptane is axially chiral: two enantiomers

cases.name: smi_isotope_unspec
cases.why: a centre made only by an isotope: the ESP cannot see it, espmap ignores isotopes

cases.name: smi_isotope_spec
cases.why: isotopic centre specified

cases.name: draw_ala_wedged
cases.why: wedges fix the centre

cases.name: draw_ala_plain
cases.source: RDKit 2D depiction of C[C@H](N)C(=O)O, stereo stripped
cases.why: no wedge: the centre is not fixed

cases.name: draw_threonine_wedged
cases.why: both centres wedged

cases.name: draw_threonine_plain
cases.source: RDKit 2D depiction of C[C@@H](O)[C@H](N)C(=O)O, stereo stripped
cases.why: no wedges on two centres

cases.name: draw_2butene_E
cases.why: a 2D double bond is drawn E or Z: the drawing fixes it

cases.name: draw_2butene_either
cases.why: a crossed ('either') double bond says E/Z is unknown

cases.name: draw_2butene_stripped
cases.source: RDKit 2D depiction of CC=CC, stereo stripped
cases.why: drawn with no E/Z: RDKit writes the bond as 'either'

cases.name: draw_ala_wavy
cases.source: RDKit 2D depiction of C[C@H](N)C(=O)O, stereo stripped
cases.why: a wavy bond at the centre says its configuration is unknown

cases.name: draw_sulfoxide_plain
cases.source: RDKit 2D depiction of C[S@](=O)CC, stereo stripped
cases.why: a sulfoxide drawn without a wedge

cases.name: draw_cyclooctene_Z
cases.why: an eight-ring double bond drawn cis

cases.name: draw_14dmch_plain
cases.source: RDKit 2D depiction of C[C@H]1CC[C@@H](C)CC1, stereo stripped
cases.why: ring stereo drawn without wedges

cases.name: draw3d_ala_plain
cases.source: RDKit 2D depiction of C[C@H](N)C(=O)O, stereo stripped, 3D header, z = 0
cases.why: a drawing under a 3D header with every z = 0 and no wedges: the flat centre fixes nothing

cases.name: draw_cyclohexene_crossed
cases.why: a crossed bond in a six-ring: no E/Z exists, so the 'either' mark says nothing

cases.name: draw_ethanol_wavy
cases.why: a wavy bond from a CH2: no stereocentre there

cases.name: draw_ala_wedged_H
cases.why: explicit hydrogens drawn, the wedge on the C-H bond

cases.name: draw3d_crotonaldehyde_E
cases.source: RDKit 2D depiction of C/C=C/C=O, 3D header, z = 0
cases.why: a drawing under a 3D header: the drawn double bond still reads E. Two element pairs, so the R11 rule calls it a drawing (2-butene alone is undecidable there)

cases.name: geo_ala_mol
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@H](N)C(=O)O, as .mol
cases.why: 3D coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_threonine_mol
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@@H](O)[C@H](N)C(=O)O, as .mol
cases.why: 3D coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_2butene_E_mol
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C/C=C/C, as .mol
cases.why: 3D coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_sulfoxide_mol
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[S@](=O)CC, as .mol
cases.why: 3D coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_14dmch_trans_mol
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@H]1CC[C@@H](C)CC1, as .mol
cases.why: 3D coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_cyclooctene_Z_mol
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C1CCC/C=C\CC1, as .mol
cases.why: 3D coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_ala_xyz
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@H](N)C(=O)O, as .xyz
cases.why: an XYZ file's coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_ala_pdb
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@H](N)C(=O)O, as .pdb
cases.why: a PDB file's coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: atoms_ala
cases.source: --atoms string from ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@H](N)C(=O)O
cases.why: --atoms coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_2butene_E_xyz
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C/C=C/C, as .xyz
cases.why: an XYZ file's coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_2butene_E_pdb
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C/C=C/C, as .pdb
cases.why: a PDB file's coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: atoms_2butene_E
cases.source: --atoms string from ETKDG + MMFF94s of C/C=C/C
cases.why: --atoms coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_12dmch_trans_xyz
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@@H]1CCCC[C@H]1C, as .xyz
cases.why: an XYZ file's coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_12dmch_trans_pdb
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@@H]1CCCC[C@H]1C, as .pdb
cases.why: a PDB file's coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: atoms_12dmch_trans
cases.source: --atoms string from ETKDG + MMFF94s of C[C@@H]1CCCC[C@H]1C
cases.why: --atoms coordinates fix every stereo element

cases.name: geo_cholesterol_sdf
cases.why: eight centres fixed by 3D coordinates

cases.name: geo_allene_mol
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of CC=C=CC, as .mol
cases.why: a 3D allene: the coordinates fix the axis, which no SMILES can

cases.name: geo_binol_mol
cases.source: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF94s of Oc1ccc2ccccc2c1-c1c(O)ccc2ccccc12, as .mol
cases.why: a 3D BINOL: the coordinates fix the atropisomer

cases.name: sdf_record1_geometry
cases.source: record 1: ETKDG + MMFF94s alanine; record 2: a plain 2D drawing
cases.why: --record 1 picks the 3D geometry, which fixes the centre

cases.name: sdf_record2_drawing
cases.source: record 1: ETKDG + MMFF94s alanine; record 2: a plain 2D drawing
cases.why: --record 2 picks the drawing, whose centre has no wedge
